45: public class HandleStandardException extends JavacAnnotationHandler<StandardException> {
46: 	@Override
47: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<StandardException> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
48: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.STANDARD_EXCEPTION_FLAG_USAGE, "@StandardException");
49: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, StandardException.class);
50: 		deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(annotationNode, "lombok.AccessLevel");
51: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
52: 		
53: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
54: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException is only supported on a class");
55: 			return;
56: 		}
57: 		
58: 		JCTree extending = Javac.getExtendsClause((JCClassDecl) typeNode.get());
59: 		if (extending == null) {
60: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException requires that you extend a Throwable type");
61: 			return;
62: 		}
63: 		
64: 		AccessLevel access = annotation.getInstance().access();
65: 		if (access == null) access = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;
66: 		if (access == AccessLevel.NONE) {
67: 			annotationNode.addError("AccessLevel.NONE is not valid here");
68: 			access = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;
69: 		}
70: 		
71: 		generateNoArgsConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
72: 		generateMsgOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
73: 		generateCauseOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
74: 		generateFullConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
75: 	}

77: 	private void generateNoArgsConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
78: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
79: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
80: 		
81: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null), maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
82: 		JCStatement thisCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("this")), args));
83: 		JCMethodDecl constr = typeNode.createConstructor(level, false, false, source, List.of(thisCall));
84: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
85: 	}
86: 	
87: 	private void generateMsgOnlyConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
88: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
89: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
90: 		
91: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("message")), maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
92: 		JCStatement thisCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("this")), args));

98: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
99: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
100: 		Name causeName = typeNode.toName("cause");
101: 		
102: 		JCExpression causeDotGetMessage = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(causeName), typeNode.toName("getMessage")), List.<JCExpression>nil());
103: 		JCExpression msgExpression = maker.Conditional(maker.Binary(CTC_NOT_EQUAL, maker.Ident(causeName), maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null)), causeDotGetMessage, maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
104: 		
105: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(msgExpression, maker.Ident(causeName));
106: 		JCStatement thisCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("this")), args));
107: 		JCMethodDecl constr = typeNode.createConstructor(level, false, true, source, List.of(thisCall));
108: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
109: 	}

111: 	private void generateFullConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
112: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
113: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
114: 		
115: 		Name causeName = typeNode.toName("cause");
116: 		Name superName = typeNode.toName("super");
117: 		
118: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("message")));
119: 		JCStatement superCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(superName), args));
120: 		JCExpression causeNotNull = maker.Binary(CTC_NOT_EQUAL, maker.Ident(causeName), maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
121: 		JCStatement initCauseCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(superName), typeNode.toName("initCause")), List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(causeName))));
122: 		JCStatement initCause = maker.If(causeNotNull, initCauseCall, null);
123: 		JCMethodDecl constr = typeNode.createConstructor(level, true, true, source, List.of(superCall, initCause));
124: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
125: 	}

127: 	private static MemberExistsResult hasConstructor(JavacNode node, Class<?>... paramTypes) {
128: 		node = upToTypeNode(node);
129: 		
130: 		if (node != null && node.get() instanceof JCClassDecl) {
131: 			for (JCTree def : ((JCClassDecl) node.get()).defs) {
132: 				if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
133: 					JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
134: 					if (md.name.contentEquals("<init>") && (md.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) == 0) {
135: 						if (!paramsMatch(node, md.params, paramTypes)) continue;
136: 						return getGeneratedBy(def) == null ? MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_USER : MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_LOMBOK;
137: 					}
138: 				}
139: 			}
140: 		}
141: 		
142: 		return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
143: 	}
144: 	
145: 	private static boolean paramsMatch(JavacNode node, List<JCVariableDecl> a, Class<?>[] b) {
146: 		if (a == null) return b == null || b.length == 0;
147: 		if (b == null) return a.size() == 0;
148: 		if (a.size() != b.length) return false;
149: 		
150: 		for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
151: 			JCVariableDecl param = a.get(i);
152: 			Class<?> c = b[i];
153: 			if (!typeMatches(c, node, param.vartype)) return false;
154: 		}
155: 		
156: 		return true;
157: 	}

part.text:
Fixed. The root cause: `@StandardException`'s generated constructors chained via `this(null, null)` / `this(message, null)`, and with two reference-typed fields `@AllArgsConstructor` also generates a two-arg constructor (`Failure(Date, Integer)`), making the uncast `null` arguments ambiguous.

Changes:
- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleStandardException.java:84` — cast the `null` arguments to `(String)`/`(Throwable)` in the no-args and msg-only constructors' `this(...)` calls (`maker.TypeCast` with `genJavaLangTypeRef`).
- `src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleStandardException.java:73` — same fix for the Eclipse handler using `CastExpression` with `generateQualifiedTypeRef`.

Validation:
- `ant test.instance` (javac/delombok suite): 416 tests, 0 failures — including the FAIL_TO_PASS `StandardExceptionWithConstructor` and `StandardExceptions` cases.
- `ant test.eclipse-202212` (ecj suite): 416 tests, 0 failures, including both ecj StandardException cases.
- End-to-end: compiled the issue's exact `@StandardException + @AllArgsConstructor` repro with the built lombok agent on javac 11 — succeeds and produces `Failure()`, `Failure(String)`, `Failure(Throwable)`, `Failure(String, Throwable)`, and `Failure(Date, Integer)`.
